Name: TT's Animal Bomb(CP)
Author: tforly
Description:
[b][size=4]

用一些可爱动物制作的炸弹！

炸弹、超级炸弹、樱桃炸弹分为带引线的版本和只有动物的版本，可以在通用模组菜单里进行配置。

爆炸弹丸用了爱心和小猪，可以用弹弓发射爱心❤超级超级可爱！


Bombs made with some cute animals!

Bomb, Mega Bomb, and Cherry Bomb are divided into versions with fuse and versions with only animals, which can be configured in the Generic Mod Config Menu.

Explosive Ammo uses love and pigs.

Shooting Love with slingshots ❤ Super cute![/size]
